evidence.quote: the head tilt isn’t a sign of confusion, as many of us may believe.

evidence.quote: He was inspired to conduct this research after taking part in the Genius Dog Challenge.

q5.explanationZh: 狗要根据名字叼来“正确的”玩具，所以填 correct。

q7.explanationZh: 前面说多数狗都失败了，however 转折，说明边境牧羊犬“完美地”通过了测试。

evidence.quote: Even two toy names proved to be too much for them.

q8.explanationZh: 后面的数据是43%和2%，差别很大，让人惊讶，所以填 surprising。

evidence.quote: The gifted learners tilted their heads 43% of the time, while the other 33 dogs did so just 2% of the time.

q9.explanationZh: 这句是在问：这些发现是不是“意味着”不歪头的狗不太聪明？mean 表示“意味着”。

evidence.quote: if it’s not tilting its head? Not really.

q10.explanationZh: 冒号后说“学习物品名称的能力”，是一种具体的“技能”，skill 和 ability 意思相近。
